summary: Implemented SortedQueue.append (maxlen check and key-sorted insertion), Resource.count, Resource._do_put/_do_get (capacity grant and release), and PreemptiveResource._do_put (preempts the least important user when a more important request arrives). The last full-suite run (`c0-test tests`) gave 96 passed and 54 failed; the failures trace to unimplemented stubs in events.py and core.py owned by other builders, and the resource tests cannot pass until those land.
